headword: {記名投票|きめいとうひょう}

definitions.explanation: A vote in which each voter's name is written on or attached to the ballot, so it is on record who voted which way. In the Diet, members cast a white ballot (for) or a blue ballot (against) bearing their name.

examples.japanese: {記名投票|きめいとうひょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
⟦{法案|ほうあん}→法案：09758_houan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{記名投票|きめいとうひょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{付|ふ}された。
examples.english: The bill was put to a recorded vote.

examples.japanese: {記名投票|きめいとうひょう}な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{反対|はんたい}した→反対する：05648_hantaisuru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{分|わ}かる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: Since it is a recorded vote, you can see at once who voted against.

notes:
The opposite is {無記名投票|むきめいとうひょう}, a secret ballot, which is how ordinary elections are held. {記名投票|きめいとうひょう} is used where voters are accountable for their votes, above all in the Diet.

CULTURAL NOTE:
- ⟦{白票|はくひょう}→白票：28194_hakuhyou⟧: the white ballot, a vote in favour
- {青票|せいひょう}: the blue ballot, a vote against
- {起立採決|きりつさいけつ}: a vote by standing, the usual method, with no names recorded

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {記名投票|きめいとうひょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{採決|さいけつ}→採決：08395_saiketsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to take a recorded vote
- {記名投票|きめいとうひょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}める→求める：02316_motomeru⟧: to call for a recorded vote
